methodology.scope: Orbital launch attempts with a resolved LL2 pad in the stored coverage window.
methodology.caution: Site and pad counts are observed activity, not a complete census of inactive infrastructure.
methodology.cadence: Median and fastest interval use NET timestamps between observed attempts on the same pad.
